lane: UI-1 compositor and stable art boxes
summary: Converted overview city pads and district art into fixed visual envelopes, moved labels outside those envelopes, removed all active full-raster motion and permanent per-image compositor promotion, disabled camera easing during direct interaction, and removed the navigation backdrop filter while preserving discrete camera transitions and reduced-motion behavior.

tests_run.result: failed before final verification on temporary parent-owned render-count ref instrumentation; 3 react-hooks/refs errors in world-scene.tsx
passed after the temporary instrumentation was removed
passed final exact package-script gate after the system npm junction was restored

tests_run.command: PowerShell CSS contract assertion scan over features/career-world/styles/career-world.css
tests_run.result: passed: no backdrop filter, translateZ promotion, or image animation/transition/transform; direct-interaction override, contain sizing, and absolute labels present

claims.claim: Overview employer buttons reserve a 132 by 96 art box through their existing inline width plus a fixed CSS height, while labels are absolutely positioned below the box so label decode and font metrics cannot move the anchor.
Capital, project, and skill figures have kind-specific fixed-height envelope fallbacks, and their cards and images fill the reserved box with object-fit contain.
Project, skill, and capital rasters no longer receive opacity, transform, transition, focus-breathe, or signal animations; interaction affordance is applied to the button outline instead.
Camera easing remains available for discrete navigation but is disabled while the scene reports direct interaction, with temporary will-change restricted to that interaction window.
The navigation panel no longer applies a backdrop filter over the moving scene.
Reduced-motion mode still disables remaining route animation and the new outline transitions.

deviations: When the system npm junction temporarily disappeared, a bundled pnpm fallback was attempted. Because node_modules was npm-installed, pnpm copied direct packages through node_modules/.ignored, attempted blocked registry access, and timed out. Normal node_modules was verified usable afterward and both direct ESLint and the restored exact npm lint gate passed; root was notified immediately.
No TSX was edited. The interaction selector is intentionally ready for the parent-owned world-scene markup to expose data-interacting=true.
risks_blockers: The direct-interaction transition override remains inert until world-scene.tsx exposes data-interacting=true on .career-world-scene during wheel or pointer interaction.

The failed pnpm fallback left an untracked .pnpm-store directory and duplicate node_modules/.ignored content. They are not source changes, but root should remove those exact temporary paths after its own path-safety check.
ledger_updates: Suggested: record UI-1 stable art envelopes and compositor cleanup as implemented and lint-green, with activation of the data-interacting markup selector pending parent integration.
